description: Claude Code settings for Modular RAG Framework. Schema follows the real Claude Code permissions/hooks model — see docs/guides/CLAUDE-CODE-COMPLETE-GUIDE.md for the narrative explanation of the 7-layer security strategy this enforces.

PostToolUse.description: Lint Python code after any file write. Checks for syntax (E), undefined names (F), and import order (I).

notes.permissionStrategy: Real Claude Code 3-bucket model: deny (always blocked, no prompt) > ask (prompts every time) > allow (auto-approved, no prompt). Paths not matched by any rule fall back to Claude Code's defaultMode behavior.
notes.tier_mapping: deny == old 'denylist' (secrets, production configs, V2-V5 reserved adapters). allow == old 'dontAsk'+'acceptEdits' tiers merged (tests/examples/docs + safe domain modules — both are 'no prompt' in the real model, there's no separate dontAsk vs acceptEdits distinction). ask == old 'restrictedPaths' (contracts, orchestration, security, adapters/embeddings, adapters/vectorstores, core, and a few root config files).
notes.hooksLimitation: The 'matcher' field matches on TOOL NAME only (e.g. 'Edit|Write'), not on file path. This hook therefore runs ruff over the whole src/modular_rag/+tests/ tree on every Edit or Write, regardless of which file changed — there is no native per-path hook filtering in Claude Code.
notes.removedFromV1: Earlier versions of this file had invented, non-functional keys: 'denylists/noAskPaths/autoPaths/restrictedPaths' (replaced by the real allow/ask/deny above), 'futureHooks' and 'parallelization' (narrative-only, never read by Claude Code — see docs/guides/claude-code-parallelization-orchestration.md for that content as documentation), and a 'mcpServers' key (MCP servers are configured in a project-root .mcp.json file, not here; this project does not currently define any MCP server).
notes.moreInfo: See CLAUDE.md (@-imports .claude/.instructions.md and .claude/.prompt.md), .claude/rules/*.md (path-scoped, auto-loaded by Claude Code when matching files are opened), and .claude/rules/security-layers.md (no path scoping — always loaded).
